source.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
source.text: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

draft.headline: A new benchmark reveals advanced AI models still struggle to handle everyday tasks reliably.

Even the most advanced AI models still struggle with basic daily tasks.

A new benchmark found that top AI assistants fail to complete everyday tasks reliably or safely. They often introduce potential new problems along the way, even as millions of people adopt personal AI tools.

Would you let an AI agent manage your daily tasks today?
